task.title: Measure many-changed projection refresh behavior
task.description:
The 2026-07-29 repository evaluation measured unchanged refresh and one changed task, but did not establish how projection refresh behaves when many task heads change between refreshes.

Using the corrected representative fixture, add deterministic refresh scenarios for 0, 1, 5, 50, and 500 changed task heads. Measure end-to-end refresh latency, Git process count, ref-enumeration work, and SQLite projection work while keeping setup and mutations outside the timed refresh. Make repository scenarios honor the requested sample count and retain identical scenario semantics in SHA-1 and SHA-256 repositories.

Acceptance: generated JSON and Markdown report every change-count point, sample count, fixture shape, and object format; tests prove the requested sample count is honored and the changed-head cardinality is exact; the report describes the measured slope without changing refresh behavior or inventing a pass threshold. Create an optimization story only if the evidence warrants it.
